project_info.theme: BADASS minigame winner announcement driving traffic to store
project_info.color_palette: Bright lemon yellow, royal blue, white, black, small orange accent

main_subject.detail: A young Asian male model stands full-height on the right side, facing front with a neutral confident expression, wearing a clean white short-sleeve polo shirt with a tiny BADASS chest logo, light beige trousers, and a black wristwatch. He is cut out cleanly and placed over a graphic poster background, occupying the lower-right half vertically.
main_subject.style: Commercial fashion poster, photorealistic model cutout, clean ecommerce campaign aesthetic, bold Vietnamese promotional typography, playful social media giveaway layout

composition_elements.text: BADASS; KẾT QUẢ MINIGAME; ĐƯỜNG ĐẾN BADASS STORE; PhAn KhAnh; Đáp án đường 2; Smm: 84; 2 ngày; Thích; Trả lời; Thứ Sáu, 15 Tháng 5, 2026 lúc 18:55; ĐÁP ÁN: 2; CHÚC MỪNG NGƯỜI CHIẾN THẮNG; BADASS
items: Top Left: large black wordmark 'BADASS' on plain yellow background.
Top Center: irregular royal blue banner with folded-paper look containing yellow uppercase text 'KẾT QUẢ MINIGAME'.
Near Banner: three small hand-drawn white arrow doodles pointing inward around the headline.
Upper Middle: oversized white headline with thick royal blue outline reading 'ĐƯỜNG ĐẾN BADASS STORE' stretching almost full width.

Center Left: layered rounded-corner screenshot card of a social comment, slightly tilted, with profile circle, the name 'PhAn KhAnh', comment text 'Đáp án đường 2' and 'Smm: 84' with the number 84 highlighted in orange, plus lower meta text and a black timestamp pill.
Lower Left-Middle: yellow rounded rectangle panel with a white speech-bubble tab on the left showing 'ĐÁP ÁN: 2' in blue, and large italic blue text 'CHÚC MỪNG NGƯỜI CHIẾN THẮNG'.
Bottom Left: simplified illustrated storefront badge labeled 'BADASS', showing a store interior in muted grayscale behind the window.
Right Side: full-body male model overlaps the headline area and lower banner, anchored to the bottom edge.
Background: soft bright yellow fabric-like draped texture with subtle folds and gentle radial lighting, plus a thick royal blue footer bar across the bottom edge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even frontal illumination on the model, soft shadowing, cheerful high-key atmosphere, slight poster glow, crisp cutout edges, clean retail campaign finish

technical_specs.render_style: Photorealistic fashion advertising poster combined with flat graphic design and UI screenshot collage

assets.name: BADASS wordmark
assets.source: Use the original BADASS brand logo/wordmark reference from the source image or brand assets.
assets.usage: Place at top left in black and again on the storefront sign at bottom left; preserve brand letterforms accurately.

assets.name: male model in white polo
assets.source: Use the source image as facial likeness, hairstyle, pose, outfit, and body-proportion reference.
assets.usage: Recreate as a realistic cutout standing front-facing on the right side with the same calm expression and clean wardrobe styling.

assets.name: Facebook comment screenshot
assets.source: Use the original screenshot from the source image as a layout and text reference.
assets.usage: Reproduce the layered comment card with readable Vietnamese text, name, orange highlighted number 84, and timestamp pill in the center-left.

assets.name: BADASS storefront illustration
assets.source: Use the source image storefront badge or an existing BADASS store facade reference.
assets.usage: Recreate the small bottom-left storefront sticker with signboard and interior view to support the 'store' reward concept.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the primary composition reference to preserve layout, spacing, and text hierarchy.
If available, attach a clean BADASS logo reference to improve wordmark fidelity.
Use the source image as the character reference for the male model so the face, hairstyle, white polo, and pose remain close to the original.
Treat the Facebook-style comment screenshot as a required reference element; reproduce the text exactly as visible and keep the orange highlight on '84'.
Keep the final output square, with the model dominating the right half and the information blocks stacked on the left half.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a BADASS minigame winner announcement driving traffic to store. Bright lemon-yellow background with soft draped fabric texture and subtle folds, plus a thick royal blue strip along the bottom edge. Top left shows the black BADASS wordmark. At the top center, place an irregular folded-paper royal blue banner with large bold yellow uppercase Vietnamese text 'KẾT QUẢ MINIGAME', surrounded by small hand-drawn white arrow doodles. Below it, add a huge white headline with thick royal blue outline reading 'ĐƯỜNG ĐẾN BADASS STORE' across the upper middle. On the center-left, place a layered rounded-corner Facebook-style comment screenshot card, slightly tilted, showing profile image, the name 'PhAn KhAnh', the text 'Đáp án đường 2', 'Smm: 84' with the number 84 highlighted in orange, and lower text '2 ngày', 'Thích', 'Trả lời', plus a black rounded timestamp strip reading 'Thứ Sáu, 15 Tháng 5, 2026 lúc 18:55'. In the lower-left middle, add a bright yellow rounded message panel with a white bubble tab reading 'ĐÁP ÁN: 2' in blue and large italic blue text 'CHÚC MỪNG NGƯỜI CHIẾN THẮNG'. At the bottom left, include a small sticker-like BADASS storefront illustration with the store sign and grayscale interior visible. On the right side, place a photorealistic full-body young Asian man cutout, front-facing, neutral expression, black styled hair, wearing a white short-sleeve polo with tiny BADASS chest logo, light beige trousers, and black watch. Poster style should feel like playful social-media campaign creative for a fashion brand. Technical style: photorealistic fashion advertising poster combined with flat graphic design and UI screenshot collage, bright soft studio-commercial lighting, cheerful high-key finish, crisp edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
